_note: Drawing-generation p95 budgets in milliseconds, checked by scripts/perf-drawings.mjs with a +20% band. See perf/README.md before changing a number: these are BASELINED FROM A DEVELOPER MACHINE and multiplied by 3 for runner headroom, which is a placeholder, not a measurement. Re-baseline from a real nightly run and drop the multiplier.

small.note: one storey, 40 elements. JIT-dominated; the floor under everything else.

medium.note: five storeys. Realistic: one floor sectioned, four rejected.

large.note: twenty storeys, 500 per floor. Rejection-dominated, which is what a real plan does.

floor-small.note: single storey: every mesh is sectioned. Half of the scaling comparison.

floor-large.note: 5000 sectioned elements on one floor. Deliberately extreme — and it exceeds the plan's 50 ms long-task budget, which is why generation belongs in a worker.
